title: Mara and the Songbook
author: Odile Winterbourne
blurb: Kestrel Coldharbour, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
